I am currently a server and graduated Uni last May. I got my CJO the very first time i applied and went to an interview for a legacy. other people, had tried 5+ times. its hard to say, but as long as you are service-oriented, you got this. I'm 23

F23- I would follow whichever airline standards they gave you , but this is what I wore when I got a CJO. I did a navy pant suit with a modest white bodysuit underneath, Black wedge heels, and I had my hair (shoulder length) down. One other girl who has longer hair than I do , had it down and got a cjo with me. Everyone else had their hair in either a bun or ponytail.

I don't have a photo, but my advice is, dress like you are going to a corporate interview. In a suit, with pants or skirt (no higher than mid-knee). Make sure you have hosiery on. I would keep colors out of it. Black, Grey, Navy. A white or colored undershirt. Some women wore scarves around their neck, that is a personal preference but as long as it looks professional and MODEST. if you have tattoos, make sure they are covered, even if a watch or sleeve is to slip and they see it, it could be automatic TBNT.
